#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int INF = 99999999;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);

    int n, K;
    cin >> n >> K;
    vector<pair<int,int>> ts(K);
    long long all = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
        cin >> ts[i].first >> ts[i].second;
        all += ts[i].second - ts[i].first;
    }

    // dp[0] = even, dp[1] = odd
    vector<vector<int>> dp(2, vector<int>(n+1, INF));
    if (ts[0].first > n) {
        cout << "Hungry\n";
        return 0;
    }
    dp[0][ts[0].first] = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
        vector<vector<int>> ndp(2, vector<int>(n+1, INF));
        deque<int> dq;
        int w = ts[i].second - ts[i].first;

        // Process dp[0] (even)
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; ++j) {
            while (!dq.empty() && dp[0][dq.back()] >= dp[0][j]) {
                dq.pop_back();
            }
            while (!dq.empty() && dq.front() < j - w) {
                dq.pop_front();
            }
            dq.push_back(j);
            ndp[1][j] = min(ndp[1][j], dp[0][dq.front()] + 1);
            if (j + w <= n) {
                ndp[0][j + w] = min(ndp[0][j + w], dp[0][j]);
            }
        }
        dq.clear();

        // Process dp[1] (odd)
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; ++j) {
            while (!dq.empty() && dp[1][dq.back()] >= dp[1][j]) {
                dq.pop_back();
            }
            while (!dq.empty() && dq.front() < j - w) {
                dq.pop_front();
            }
            dq.push_back(j);
            ndp[0][j] = min(ndp[0][j], dp[1][dq.front()] + 1);
            ndp[1][j] = min(ndp[1][j], dp[1][j]);
        }

        dp = move(ndp);

        for (int j = 0; j <= n; ++j) {
            dp[0][j] = min(dp[0][j], dp[1][j] + 1);
            dp[1][j] = min(dp[1][j], dp[0][j] + 1);
        }

        int s = (i == K-1 ? 2*n : ts[i+1].first) - ts[i].second;
        for (int j = n; j >= s; --j) {
            dp[0][j] = dp[0][j - s];
        }
        for (int j = min(n, s-1); j >= 0; --j) {
            dp[0][j] = INF;
        }
    }

    int ans = min(dp[0][n], dp[1][n]);
    if (ans >= 9999999) {
        cout << "Hungry\n";
    } else {
        cout << "Full\n" << ans << "\n";
    }

    return 0;
}
